LAB ONLY. 'set system scripts language python3' is already set on this device; this install relies on it. It lets any unsigned Python script owned by a super-user-class account run on this device's routing engine, not only J-Wicket: a change to the device's security posture that someone made before. J-Wicket is not qualified for production (gate G1 has not passed). Continue only on a disposable lab device you are allowed to change.
LAB ONLY. With --access tls the runtime commit opens a new HTTPS listener on this device's management address: the --listen-address, by default --host, which the installer does not check is the management address (an address of a revenue interface would put the listener there; in the mgmt_junos routing instance when 'system management-instance' is set). It is reachable by anything that reaches that address: J-Wicket's sign-in page becomes one more way into this device, beside SSH and NETCONF. Its certificate is self-signed; compare its SHA-256 fingerprint in the browser with the one the installer prints. J-Wicket has not passed gate G1 or a security review (Q-SEC-01). Continue only on a lab device whose management network you control.
J-Wicket will run with the rights of labadmin, a super-user-class account that can commit configuration ('username labadmin' under 'system extensions extension-service application file jwicket.py'). A compromise of J-Wicket is a compromise of this device.
The netconf backend's reach to the device's own NETCONF ('show configuration system services netconf') rests on the probe (check C3) only: it is not checked end to end, because no check uses an SSH channel (SSH forwarding was refused on the lab SRX4100). Sign in once to prove it.

Unit 7 (workstation): open the UI in a browser (workstation)
Status: HTTPS on the management address verified on SRX4100 25.2R1-S1.4 (TLS 1.2 and 1.3)

Browse to https://192.0.2.10:9443/ from a host on the management network. The browser warns about a self-signed certificate: accept it only if its SHA-256 fingerprint is 5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B:5B.
